verdict.rationale: Gmail documents standard IMAP, POP and SMTP access for non-Gmail clients and supports adding the account to Outlook, Apple Mail or Thunderbird, so the core of protocol-level reachability is there. However, no standards-based bulk export is evidenced; the only extraction path shown is the proprietary Gmail API, which does use RFC 2822 MIME. A community report also says the IMAP implementation is incomplete: IDLE does not signal read-status changes. Missing for 10: JMAP support, a documented standards-based export (e.g. mbox), full IMAP spec conformance, and independent corroboration that switching away works smoothly.
